trust_decision.summary: Stored wizard content (step markdown, step titles, button widget url/text, and any data spliced into them, including imported third-party bundles) is evaluated as Jinja with the full Flask app environment and a context holding every Settings row; nothing decides that this text is untrusted. The fix makes the decision in a new restricted sandbox (render_wizard_template plus an allowlisted wizard_context) that every render site must call.

landing_point.why: The summary says 'SSTI in wizard step rendering'; _render's current_app.jinja_env.overlay(...).from_string(...) is the obvious wizard step render call.

fix_sites.module_kind: route helper (primary sink); also reorders widget/card processing to run after Jinja

fix_sites.entry_point: GET /settings/wizard/ with HX-Request (list_steps, app/blueprints/wizard_admin/routes.py:62-105) renders step.title|render_jinja at app/templates/settings/wizard/steps.html:86 and :166
fix_sites.module_kind: Jinja template filter in app root (second implementation, admin list view)

O2_out_of_scope_site.where: app/jinja_filters.py:184-188 (render_jinja filter, used for step titles at app/templates/settings/wizard/steps.html:86 and :166); also the ButtonWidget render_template_string calls at app/services/wizard_widgets.py:229, :244, :255

O3_reason_to_dismiss: render_jinja only renders titles in the admin's own settings list, and its comment says 'render_template_string auto-escapes' (app/jinja_filters.py:188), so a solver can argue it is an escaped admin-only display path, not 'wizard step rendering'.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: Built-in and seeded steps need _() translations, {{ external_url }}/settings.server_name lookups, {% if %} conditions, |||cards, {{ widget:button url="external_url" text=_("...") }}, the recently_added_media carousel and the Discord preset iframe. A fix that escapes all Jinja, drops `_`, or empties `settings` breaks them (the fix's own test renders every wizard_steps/*/*.md, fix.diff:745-764).

O6_input_shapes: Jinja expression in step markdown body ({{ ... }})
button text starting with _( (wrapped into {{ }} before rendering)
button url as bare identifier (wrapped into {{ url }} and rendered)
button url containing {{ or {% (skipped by the pinned startswith('{{') check, now rendered in the sandbox)
second-order: widget output / context values / media item titles placed into template source before Jinja runs
dict item lookup of secret Settings keys through `settings` (no attribute access needed)
widget args containing a quoted '}' (quote-aware WIDGET_PATTERN)
resource-heavy binops (*, **, %) and loops (secondary, output-length limits)

O7_producer.where: app/blueprints/wizard/routes.py:128-180 (_settings loads every Settings row, e.g. admin_password read at app/blueprints/auth/routes.py:87 and ombi_api_key at app/services/ombi_client.py:20) merged into the render context at app/blueprints/wizard/routes.py:375, :1045, :1238, :1403 and exposed as `settings` at :298. Second producer: widget HTML (media titles via app/services/wizard_widgets.py:37 and :61) is produced at routes.py:310-313 and then compiled as template source at :317.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: a new registry widget (e.g. a 'server_info' or 'notice' widget) that passes a placeholder kwarg through render_template_string or into self.template
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: The base WizardWidget.render already calls render_template_string with widget data, and ButtonWidget shows maintainers rendering kwargs as Jinja for translations.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: a preset whose admin-supplied value (str.format) lands inside a {{ }} expression rather than a quoted widget arg
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: Presets already splice form values into Jinja-bearing markdown with str.format, e.g. the overseerr_url widget preset at app/services/wizard_presets.py:74.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: bundle step titles rendered with |render_jinja like steps.html does
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: steps.html:86 already applies render_jinja to the same WizardStep.title field to translate {{ _('...') }} titles; bundles.html shows them raw, an inconsistency a maintainer could 'fix'.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: a second filter (e.g. render_markdown for bundle descriptions or invite messages) built on render_template_string
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: register_filters is the project's place for display helpers, and render_jinja is the model for one.

O9_family: code/template injection (server-side Jinja SSTI, CWE-1336) with secret disclosure through template context

O10_build.toolchain: uv + pyproject.toml/uv.lock, Flask, flask-babel, Jinja2, python-markdown, pytest/pytest-flask
O10_build.project_tests: tests/test_wizard_rendering.py, tests/test_wizard_widgets.py, tests/test_wizard_preview_steps.py, tests/test_wizard_export_import.py, tests/test_wizard_presets_service.py (fix adds tests/test_wizard_template_security.py)

j.j_tempting_wrong_fix: Swap current_app.jinja_env.overlay for jinja2.sandbox.SandboxedEnvironment in _render only, leaving the full Settings dict in context, widget output compiled as template source, the render_jinja title filter and the ButtonWidget render_template_string calls.

out_of_scope_notes: app/blueprints/wizard/routes.py:46-53: when wizard_acl_enabled is 'false' the wizard routes are open to everyone, which widens who can trigger rendering; that is an access-control setting, not this advisory.
app/blueprints/wizard_admin/routes.py:457-463 and the new nh3 sanitizer are stored-XSS hardening bundled into the same fix; it is a different weakness class from the SSTI.
app/blueprints/media_servers/routes.py:328-334 concatenates a constant class string into render_template_string; no user-controlled source.
unverified: repo_mb not measured (no shell size check run); tiny_repo/giant_repo not evaluated.
O1 counts 6 wizard routes plus the /settings/wizard/ title view; bundle import (POST /settings/wizard/import) and preset creation are counted as data producers, not separate render entry points.
Whether a media server item title can contain '{{' after the media client mapping was not traced through app/services/media/*.

Hidden tests in the published fix also assert XSS sanitization (fix.diff:621-640, 784-858); if those are reused, the task mixes SSTI with an HTML-sanitizer requirement that the SSTI report may not imply.
